query: LongCat Avatar via GGUF (longcat_i2v_testing.json adapted to UnetLoaderGGUF) crashes during weight loading with KeyError: 'multitalk_audio_proj.proj1.weight' at nodes_model_loading.py load_weights. Same GGUF flow worked after the LongCat GGUF support fix in #1841 for others but still failed here.

desired.outcome: Root cause (diagnosed in #1841 by vantagewithai): the loader renamed tensors containing 'audio_proj' to 'multitalk_audio_proj' unconditionally, double-renaming already-prefixed GGUF tensor names; fix guards the rename and handles LongCat 1D/2D modulation, merged into the wrapper. Reporter confirmed it works after updating to the nightly WanVideoWrapper build (plus letting ComfyUI updates fully apply).
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies the correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.

_tags.hidden_requirement: Tests whether the solver checks custom-node version/changelog for a known tensor-double-rename bug before debugging the workflow graph
